relations.subject: James Wilson Bright
relations.evidence: He was a Professor of English Philology at Johns Hopkins University

relations.subject: James Wilson Bright
relations.evidence: Bright completed his undergraduate education at Lafayette College in Easton, Pennsylvania.

relations.subject: James Wilson Bright
relations.evidence: Bright was the first person to receive a PhD in English from Johns Hopkins, in 1882.

relations.subject: James Wilson Bright
relations.evidence: After teaching briefly at Cornell, he returned to Johns Hopkins in 1885

relations.subject: James Wilson Bright
relations.evidence: Bright became the first occupant of the Caroline Donovan Chair of English, which was established in 1905. He held the chair until his retirement in 1925.

relations.subject: John Calvin French
relations.evidence: His successor as Chairman (though not as Donovan Professor) was John Calvin French.
